name: Soul
text_1: With an emphasis on wellness and rejuvenation, Soul is a sanctuary that seamlessly integrates nature into its architecture and ethos, designed to provide a serene escape from city life.

Upon entering Soul, cosily nestled on La Mer South Island, through its double-height foyer, our clients are greeted by a lush garden that runs alongside the atrium, inviting light and greenery into the central spaces. The ground floor features an open-plan living area with a show kitchen at its heart, promoting a sense of togetherness and comfort.
text_2: The lower ground floor is dedicated to well-being, housing a gym, spa, sauna, and ice bath. An outdoor sunken garden enhances relaxation with a plunge pool, complemented by a cantilevered pool above, emphasizing the interplay of water at various levels. The crowning feature is the roof terrace, showcasing a glass floor sky pool that allows light to cascade below.
Offering breathtaking views of the sea and city skyline, this tranquil space encourages families to unwind and recharge away from the hustle and bustle of urban life.
